description:
SSB stage of the library (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decision 6). Replace random.Random(42) generation with a fixed-block per-table RNG in benchbox-datagen, bump the SSB generator version, and migrate SSB_EXPECTED_ROW_COUNTS in benchbox/core/expected_results/ssb_results.py. Legacy generation stays behind --datagen-backend legacy.

Decision gate: the acceptance report needs owner approval before golden hashes and row counts are frozen.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
